integrity_notes: Constructive polyhedral good-cover proof and finite enumerator are supplied. The finite computations corroborate but do not prove the uniform theorem; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three indistinguishable particles on a finite equilateral metric star with at least three arms, each of positive length.
Geodesic separation uses non-strict inequalities; collision is allowed only at the zero-parameter symmetric-product stage.
Only homotopy types of individual parameter stages are established, not the structure maps of persistence modules.
No claim is made for unequal arm lengths, more particles, or labels.
title: Three-particle homotopy transitions on equilateral metric stars
